statute_note: Principal source selected: the LankaLaw HTML consolidated edition (58-1947-matrimonial-rights-and-inheritance-jaffna-ordinance-consolidated.html, page 2001Y3V58C = 2001 revised edition, volume 3, chapter 58), parsed into 58-1947-matrimonial-rights-and-inheritance-jaffna-ordinance.json: 5 Parts, 40 sections, no Schedule; already structurally_verified, with the citation corrected to No. 1 of 1911 and the title to 'Jaffna Matrimonial Rights and Inheritance Ordinance' from section 1. Other sources inspected: the registry PDF statutes/58-1947-matrimonial-rights-and-inheritance-jaffna-ordinance.pdf (LankaLaw, 'CHAPTER 70', 5 pp.); the previous manifest called it an image scan, but it is a scan with an embedded OCR text layer of poor quality, carried as a verification source and not parsed. Its header reads 'Ordinances Nos. 1 of 1911, 58 of 1947. [17th July. 1911.]', agreeing with the HTML; its text layer carries none of the five inline markers the HTML prints. Consolidation cutoff: Ordinance No. 58 of 1947, from both header blocks and the HTML markers '[ 2,58 of 1947]' to '[6, 58 of 1947]' on sections 2, 6, 7, 19 and 20. Review performed: header, chain, head date and section 1 read in both copies; the tree's 40 headings and node texts run against the PDF text layer (8-word chunk matching) and spot-checked by eye; where the PDF is legible it agrees with the HTML and the non-matches are column interleaving and OCR noise, so no substantive disagreement was found, at spot level only. Validator: zero errors, zero warnings. Registry discrepancy (recorded, not fixed): source-registry.csv, the RUBRIK and this folder name call the Ordinance No. 58 of 1947 and list No. 1 of 1911 as its amendment. Both held copies say the opposite: 1 of 1911 is the principal (listed first, head date 17 July 1911) and 58 of 1947 the amending Ordinance (five markers). The tree is right; the registry form is kept under alternate_titles and citation_correction; the folder is not renamed and the registry not edited. The curriculum's item 014 'Tesawalamai "Pre-emption" Ordinance No. 1 of 1911' has the numbers of the two Thesawalamai instruments crossed: 1 of 1911 is this Ordinance, and the Thesawalamai Pre-emption Ordinance is No. 59 of 1947 (SRC046). Amendment coverage: one amending instrument, 58 of 1947, incorporated in the baseline and not held as its own text; the RUBRIK's '1 of 1911' row is the principal, not an amendment. Section 40 of this Ordinance repeals so much of the Thesawalamai collection and of section 8 of the Wills Ordinance as is inconsistent with it, which is why '1 of 1911' appears in the Wills Ordinance's chain (see that package). Nothing applied. OCR or structural weaknesses: the PDF's OCR layer; five marked sections whose 1947 wording cannot be compared with the 1911 text because 58 of 1947 is not held; section 3 and section 10 have their text only in subsections (as printed). Missing sources: own text of 58 of 1947; a printed revised edition. Unresolved questions: none beyond the registry inversion, which the coordinator should carry to source-registry.csv. Lawyer-verification status: unverified. Everything here is pipeline output.
